result.title: StickFigure: Enabling Pose-Only IoT Cameras for Privacy-Preserving Edge Vision
result.summary: Indoor IoT cameras can support assisted living and activity-aware spaces, but exporting raw RGB frames raises privacy concerns by exposing facial, clothing, and household details that body-motion tasks often do not require. We present StickFigure, a pose-only IoT camera system that, during real-time monitoring, keeps raw frames local and ephemeral while exporting only compact skeleton streams sufficient for downstream human activity recognition (HAR). While pose estimation has matured on GPUs, extracting accurate pose streams on resource-constrained IoT cameras remains difficult. To overcome these challenges and enable on-device pose streams on (almost) any IoT camera, we present two core designs in StickFigure: an activation-aware pose backbone that allocates channel capacity after spatial downsampling and a lightweight hierarchical MLP refiner that selectively corrects elbow and wrist coordinates using intermediate visual features and kinematic context. We fully implement StickFigure and evaluate it on public benchmarks and real-world deployment. Compared with state-of-the-art MCU pose models, StickFigure achieves the highest pose accuracy and downstream HAR utility on both NTU RGB+D and Penn Action, while using 96.5% fewer parameters and 99.3% fewer MACs per frame than RTMPose-S-based baselines, achieving 0.107 s p95 latency on a representative STM32H753 MCU. We believe StickFigure establishes a new operating point for privacy-aware edge vision on massive IoT cameras.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 StickFigure，一个只导出骨架姿态流的隐私保护 IoT 摄像头系统：原始帧本地留存并即时丢弃，端侧通过激活感知的姿态骨干与分层 MLP 精修器（仅用中间视觉特征和运动学上下文修正肘、腕坐标）生成紧凑姿态流，供下游人体活动识别使用。
AI.relevance_reason: 用任务充分的紧凑姿态流替代原始视觉输入、并只对少数关键坐标做选择性修正，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、稀疏状态更新与信息瓶颈的关系，但该工作本身不涉及推理期 latent 状态。
